P9D-H01.name: Order-Book Depth Imbalance
P9D-H01.statement: Short-horizon bid/ask depth imbalance contains directional predictive information about subsequent returns after controlling for Phase 9C regime and volatility.
P9D-H01.mathematical_definition: Imbalance = (BidDepth - AskDepth) / (BidDepth + AskDepth); test Corr(Imbalance_t, Return_{t+h} | Regime_t)
P9D-H01.statistical_test: Partial Spearman rank correlation & logistic regression controlling for realized_vol and regime
P9D-H01.rejection_criteria: FDR q-value >= 0.05 or Spearman IC <= 0.02 or gross edge <= 0 bps
P9D-H01.support_criteria: FDR q-value < 0.05, Spearman IC > 0.03, and net edge > 0 bps after total dynamic friction

P9D-H02.name: Spread State and Adverse Price Drift
P9D-H02.statement: Relative bid/ask spread predicts subsequent adverse price movement, volatility expansion, and execution cost deterioration.
P9D-H02.mathematical_definition: Spread_bps = (AskPrice - BidPrice) / MidPrice * 10000; test Corr(Spread_bps_t, Forward_Vol_{t+h})
P9D-H02.statistical_test: Spearman rank correlation and linear regression against forward volatility / execution penalty
P9D-H02.support_criteria: FDR q-value < 0.05, Spearman IC > 0.05, predicting execution friction and dispersion
P9D-H02.evaluation_notes: Spread state failed to predict forward volatility (IC=0.0000, p=1.000e+00).

P9D-H03.name: Trade-Flow Imbalance Persistence
P9D-H03.statement: Aggressor-side trade volume imbalance contains incremental directional information about subsequent returns beyond OHLCV volume proxies.
P9D-H03.mathematical_definition: TFI = (BuyVolume - SellVolume) / (BuyVolume + SellVolume); test Incremental IC(TFI_t, Return_{t+h}) beyond rel_volume_48
P9D-H03.statistical_test: Incremental R^2 and delta rank IC over Phase 9C volume features
P9D-H03.rejection_criteria: Delta rank IC <= 0.01 or FDR q-value >= 0.05
P9D-H03.support_criteria: Delta rank IC > 0.02 with FDR q < 0.05 and positive net expectancy after dynamic friction
P9D-H03.evaluation_notes: Trade flow imbalance has negligible forward predictability (IC=0.0000, p=1.000e+00).

P9D-H04.name: Microstructure x Regime Interaction
P9D-H04.statement: Microstructure order-book and trade-flow imbalance become significantly more informative under high-volatility and trending regime states.
P9D-H04.mathematical_definition: Interaction = Imbalance * HighVol_Dummy; test Beta(Interaction) in predicting Return_{t+h}
P9D-H04.statistical_test: Likelihood ratio test and interaction coefficient t-test across regime subsets
P9D-H04.rejection_criteria: Interaction p-value >= 0.05 across all tested horizons
P9D-H04.support_criteria: Statistically significant interaction coefficient (q < 0.05) with higher IC in target regimes
P9D-H04.evaluation_notes: Regime interaction was not statistically significant across validation partitions.

P9D-H05.name: Microstructure Incremental Information Content
P9D-H05.statement: Combining microstructure variables with Phase 9C causal features produces statistically significant incremental accuracy and net expectancy over Phase 9C features alone (Model B vs Baseline A).
P9D-H05.mathematical_definition: Delta_AUC = AUC(Model_B) - AUC(Baseline_A); Delta_Expectancy = Expectancy(Model_B) - Expectancy(Baseline_A)
P9D-H05.statistical_test: Block bootstrap CI of Delta_AUC and DeLong / permutation test for ROC comparison
P9D-H05.rejection_criteria: Delta_AUC <= 0 or 95% CI of Delta_AUC overlaps 0 or Delta_Expectancy <= 0 bps
P9D-H05.support_criteria: Delta_AUC > 0.015 (p < 0.05) and Delta_Net_Expectancy > 0 bps after dynamic friction
P9D-H05.evaluation_notes: Delta AUC=+0.0021 is not statistically significant.
